name: Quick Pro XR:ONE GRX Di2 1×12
why_interesting: A 50 mm-clearance adventure build with in-frame storage, extensive mounts, GRX Di2 and an official global list price.
missing: Mainland delivery, duties, returns, and warranty-handling confirmation
price_status: exact selected mainland Tmall build observed
required_before_dashboard: Mainland delivery, returns, invoice and local warranty evidence

observed_price.price_basis: Glass-yellow configuration two, size M, Shimano GRX Di2 1×12 complete bike; SKU 6181047722909

source_note: The exact official flagship-store Tmall listing maps configuration two to the tracked Shimano GRX Di2 1×12 build. Glass-yellow, size M, SKU 6181047722909 was selected at CNY 19,398. The listing also documents a CNY 10,998 frameset package and five other complete configurations; those remain separate. Official global-store price is US$4,399.

facts.frame_material: High-strength and high-modulus carbon; exact fiber supplier and grade are not published on the current complete-bike page
facts.frame_construction: One-piece monocoque construction with integrated in-frame storage and up to 26 frame and fork mounting points
facts.stiffness_evidence: No attributable exact-model measured stiffness result or sufficiently specific independent ride assessment was found; manufacturer efficiency and ride-feel language remains marketing only
facts.frame_weight_basis: Official size-M frame value, ±5%; fork is listed separately at 449 g

support_note: Official support page states a five-year frameset warranty for the original purchaser, one-year Shimano/SRAM coverage on complete bikes, mostly assembled delivery, and typical standard-bike delivery around three weeks; mainland-China service and delivery are not confirmed.
